seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 11667 (April 19, 1972; 37 FR 7763) was read in the held official Federal Register scan (fr-originals OCR of PDF pages 7-8: heading, preamble, sections 1-3, signature block and FR Doc. 72-6171 filing line, so the text is complete). Its operative content is the establishment and composition of the President's Advisory Committee on the Environmental Merit Awards Program (sec. 1(a)), three committee functions (sec. 1(b)), the no-compensation/travel-expense rule (sec. 2) and EPA administrative support (sec. 3); the preamble is narrative. The order has no expiry, sunset, report deadline or condition. Because the committee existed before the Federal Advisory Committee Act took effect (January 5, 1973), it would have terminated on January 5, 1975 unless renewed; EO 11827 section 1(8) (held, 40 FR 1218) renewed it until January 5, 1977. Before that date EO 11948 (held, 41 FR 55706) section 4(a)(1) revoked EO 11667, and section 5 makes EO 11948 effective December 31, 1976; section 3's separate January 16, 1977 date applies only to EO 11868. So the first and only end of every clause is the revocation effective December 31, 1976, and the whole-order end is that date. The OFR catalog (revoked by EO 11948; continued by EO 11827) and the 1989 OFR Codification disposition table (continued by EO 11827; revoked by EO 11948) agree, and no other amendment, revocation or statute affecting the order was found in the bounded searches listed (no U.S. Code or eCFR citation of the order). Quotations are the scan's OCR text, kept as printed (soft hyphens at line ends).

savings_residuals.reason: EO 11948 revokes EO 11667 without any saving or transition clause (its only other provisions continue a different list of committees, delegate FACA functions for those committees, revoke other orders and supersede EO 11827). EO 11667 created an advisory committee, its award-selection function, an uncompensated-service rule with travel expenses, and EPA administrative support; it conferred no vested rights or continuing obligations. Awards already conferred were completed honorary acts. The Environmental Merit Awards Program itself was announced by the President in 1971 (EO 11667 preamble) and was not created by this order; any later EPA award activity rests on EPA's own authority and is not attributed to EO 11667.
